title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2013.

2.—(1) Readymix Holdings International Pte Ltd is hereby granted exemption from tax on the dividends received in Singapore on or after 9th June 2011 from PJ Corporation Sdn Bhd, a company located in Brunei.
(2) The exemption under sub-paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 11th December 2012 addressed to Readymix Holdings International Pte Ltd.
